register.labelZh: CASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cash in on 可以描述商戶或個人如何利用潮流、事件或公眾興趣來賺錢。；cash something in 可以描述把旅行支票、中獎票券或投資等兌換成現金。；cash up 可以自然地描述在營業結束時點算並核對當日收到的款項。；cash in on、cash something in 和 cash up 都包含 CASH,但分別表示利用情況獲利、兌換現金和點算營業款項。
register.summaryEn: Cash in on helps you describe how a business or person uses a trend, event or public interest to make money. Cash something in can describe exchanging travellers’ cheques, prize tickets, investments or similar items for cash. Cash up lets you talk naturally about counting and checking the money received during the day. Cash in on, cash something in and cash up all contain CASH, but they describe profit, exchanging something for money and checking business takings.
